units.source_text: 我打开通向漱清亭的西门。

en.t: I opened the west gate leading to Soseitei.

units.source_text: 正如前述，这扇门扉是内侧向左右对开的。

en.t: As I mentioned before, this gate opened outward to the left and right from the inside.

units.source_text: 雨夜的天空也比金阁的内部明亮。

en.t: Even the sky on that rainy night was brighter than the inside of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 潮湿的门扉吸收了又低又轻的辊轧声，

en.t: The damp gate absorbed the low, light rolling sound,

units.source_text: 导入了充盈于微风中的深蓝色的夜气。

en.t: and drew in the deep blue night air that filled the breeze.
